en: Roxie
Hey, you made it through my band! Bet my poison's still ringing in your ears!
I'm Roxie, Leader of this Gym and singer of this band. Get ready, 'cause I'm gonna knock some sense into you!
Aaargh! What am I doing, losing like that?! ...Guess that means you're the real deal.
That stank, but I gave it everything I had, and now I feel totally refreshed! Here, the Toxic Badge!
{player} received the Toxic Badge from Roxie!
And take this TM too. Use it however you like, just make it loud!
Doing what you love, the way you want to do it, with the Pokémon you love. That's the best, right?
Just don't go causing trouble for other people while you're at it. Got it?
The music's too loud! She can't hear a word over the band.
Your Pokémon WANTED that win! Keep going like that, and do all sorts of amazing stuff!
Scout
Hey, you there! Watching you battle Roxie, I just knew it. You've got star quality!
I'm a talent scout for Pokéstar Studios. Come and see us! Well... once the auditions are done. They're shooting nonstop right now.
Roxie
Pokéstar Studios?! Oh, no, I forgot about the old man! I have to drag him back to his ship!
Scout
Oh dear. I hope the captain's audition is over before she gets there... See you at the studios one day!
Scout
Roxie puts on a show, doesn't she? If only she'd come to the studios... She's always too busy with her band.
